newsitem.title: USA: Valspar expects ValsparCoates to add to EPS.
newsitem.headline: Valspar expects ValsparCoates to add to EPS.

text.p: Valspar Corp, a paint and coatings manufacturer, said it expects ValsparCoates to add to earnings in fiscal 1997.
ValsparCoates was formed when the global metal coatings and inks business of Total SA was acquired in May 1996. Its results were included in Valspar's fourth quarter which ended October 25.

ValsparCoates, which recently announced plans to close two ink blending facilities, has implemented other manufacturing and administrative concolidations in Europe to improve cost competitiveness in that market.
Earlier, Valspar posted fourth-quarter earnings of $17.3 million or $0.78 per share, up from $14.5 million or $0.66 per share a year ago. Sales gained to $238.6 million from $205.6 million.
